info.title: PhanthyCode AI API (reverse-engineered)
info.summary: Anonymous-surface, evidence-graded OpenAPI model of https://code.phanthy.com
info.description:
Reverse-engineered description of the PhanthyCode AI surface at https://code.phanthy.com, derived from the M1 anonymous capture window 2026-10-26T05:58:24+08:00 → 2026-10-26T06:14:37+08:00 (evidence/M1-index.md:15) plus the in-repo prior art. No authenticated request, no login, no token exchange and no credential use was performed while producing this document.

EVIDENCE GRADES USED THROUGHOUT
- VERIFIED: directly observed on the live target during the M1 anonymous capture; anchored to a file:line in /workspace/re/evidence/.
- PRIOR-ART: derived only from the in-repo Go implementation / README (e.g. cmd/login/main.go, internal/upstream/client.go). Describes what this repository does, NOT what the target does.
- INFERRED: reasoned from protocol metadata or convention, basis stated inline. Must be re-tested.
- BLOCKED-CRED: requires the user's own token; nothing was fabricated.

AUTHENTICATED BEHAVIOUR IS PRIOR-ART / BLOCKED-CRED. In particular the request wire contract of POST /v1/messages and the concrete success bodies of POST /oauth/token, POST /oauth/revoke, GET /api/oauth/profile and GET /api/oauth/claude_cli/roles have never been observed. Where a schema is marked prior-art it is a model of the repository's client, not a live capture. The model roster has TWO layers that are not joined - a PUBLIC-MARKETING display-alias layer and a PRIOR-ART alias->upstream layer (see the M6 ADDENDUM at the end). The PRIOR-ART layer is unverified live: GET /v1/models returns the HTML 404 shell (evidence/M1-anon-probe-matrix.txt:73).

VERIFIED ABSENT (must not be treated as operations): GET /v1/models, POST /v1/messages/count_tokens, GET /api/health, GET /healthz, POST /api/oauth/phanthy_cli/create_api_key, POST /api/oauth/claude_cli/create_api_key. All six return a 404 Next.js HTML shell (26,573–26,614 B) rather than a JSON error (evidence/M1-anon-probe-matrix.txt:67-68, 72-73, 78-79; docs/01-endpoint-catalog.md:443-462).

DOCUMENTED TARGET-SIDE ERROR ENVELOPE: only three codes have ever been observed, all sharing {"error":{"code","message"}}: unsupported_response_type (evidence/M1-anon-probe-matrix.txt:112), missing_login (:163, :190), invalid_platform (:245, :365). There is no JSON 404 taxonomy: unknown API paths return the HTML app shell, so this document intentionally models no JSON 404 body.

GOVERNANCE: the capture and this model follow docs/00-governance.md (read-only reverse engineering, no auth bypass, no brute force, no DoS, no L2 secret persistence). No secret appears here; only <api_key>, <token>, <access_token>, <authorization_code>, <pkce_code_verifier> placeholders are used.

M6 ADDENDUM (2026-10-26) — 17 ENDPOINTS. Two model-discovery operations were added after (a) anonymous live probes and (b) static analysis of the official npm CLI @phanthy/phanthy-codeo@0.2.11 (tarball sha256 3134d33d4eba31ec0af543a8afa061d3b21c4df7259d49decc11928e2244d80c, extracted with tar -xzf and never installed, imported or executed; evidence/M6-npm-package.json, evidence/M6-cli-config.txt). GET /api/phanthy_code/models and GET /api/phanthy_code/models/stats answer OPTIONS 204 with `allow: GET, HEAD, OPTIONS`, and anonymous GET/HEAD 401 application/json (79 B) {"error":{"code":"missing_login","message":"Bearer access token is required."}} with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="phanthy-code" (evidence/M6-new-endpoint-probes.txt). Their success bodies remain BLOCKED-CRED: no schema and no example are asserted. The CLI declares the same two paths alongside /oauth/authorize, /oauth/token, /api/oauth/profile and /v1/messages, and on /v1/messages it DELETES x-api-key and sends Authorization: Bearer <access_token> only; apiKeyAuth is therefore retained solely as an unverified prior-art alternative. Both model operations use bearerAuth.

MODEL ROSTER — TWO LAYERS, NOT JOINED. PUBLIC-MARKETING layer: 13 display aliases with credit multipliers on https://code.phanthy.com/token-plan (evidence/M6-public-model-catalog.txt). PRIOR-ART layer: the Iris/Zeus/Gaia/Apollo/Metis mapping in README.md / internal/upstream/payload.go. No alias-to-upstream-ID mapping has been established; never merge the two lists. Neither layer is a live API catalogue.

get.description:
VERIFIED: GET / returned 200 text/html (56,923 B transferred, streamed with no content-length) and a Next.js app shell with lang="zh-CN" (evidence/M1-anon-probe-matrix.txt:59, 87-101; M1-root-headers.txt:7-31). No authentication and no parameters.

METHOD-DISCOVERY ANOMALY: OPTIONS / returns 400 with a 0-byte body and no Allow header, while GET / returns 200 (evidence/M1-options-matrix.txt:14, 37-52). This is an app-router artifact, not an auth signal; it is why method discovery must use OPTIONS on API paths only.

This operation is included for completeness of the observed surface; it carries no JSON protocol semantics.

200.description: VERIFIED: HTML app shell. Streamed; no content-length header is emitted (evidence/M1-anon-probe-matrix.txt:83).

strict-transport-security.description: VERIFIED: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains (the only security header observed).

cache-control.description: VERIFIED: private, must-revalidate, no-cache, no-store, max-age=0.

get.description:
EXISTENCE VERIFIED (EX-400): an anonymous GET without parameters reaches input validation and returns a JSON error, proving the handler exists and that validation precedes login (docs/01-endpoint-catalog.md:142-170; evidence/M1-anon-probe-matrix.txt:60, 104-112).

PARAMETER SET — PRIOR-ART from cmd/login/main.go:144-154. `response_type=code` is VERIFIED as the only accepted value by the server's own error text; `code_challenge_method=S256` is VERIFIED by discovery metadata (evidence/M1-openid-configuration.json:14-16). The success redirect (302 to redirect_uri with code and state) is INFERRED from RFC 6749 §4.1.2 and cmd/login/main.go:69-71; it has never been observed (BLOCKED-CRED requires an interactive browser login).

CLIENT IDENTITY: public client, client_id=phanthy-code-cli, no client secret (token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported=[none] — evidence/M1-openid-configuration.json:17-19; cmd/login/main.go:28, 146).
get.x-evidence-grade: VERIFIED (existence, error text); PRIOR-ART (parameters); INFERRED (success redirect)

parameters.name: response_type
parameters.description: VERIFIED: only `code` is supported. A missing value produces `unsupported_response_type` with the message `Only authorization code flow is supported.` (evidence/M1-anon-probe-matrix.txt:60, 112).

parameters.name: redirect_uri
parameters.description: PRIOR-ART: https://code.phanthy.com/oauth/code/success, replayed verbatim at token exchange (cmd/login/main.go:148, 182).

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: PRIOR-ART requested scope string, space-delimited: `user:inference user:profile user:sessions:claude_code` (cmd/login/main.go:149). All five advertised scope names are VERIFIED at evidence/M1-openid-configuration.json:20-26; `user:mcp_servers` and `user:file_upload` are advertised but never requested by the prior art.

parameters.name: code_challenge_method
parameters.description: VERIFIED: S256 is the only supported method (evidence/M1-openid-configuration.json:14-16; cmd/login/main.go:151).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: PRIOR-ART: the CLI uses the static value `p2a-login`, which provides no CSRF binding (cmd/login/main.go:152). A per-flow random state is recommended.

400.description: VERIFIED: input validation failure before any auth check. Exactly this body and code were observed for a parameterless request (101 B — evidence/M1-anon-probe-matrix.txt:60, 112).

error.message: Only authorization code flow is supported.

post.summary: Exchange an authorization code or refresh token for tokens
post.description:
EXISTENCE VERIFIED, BODY NOT EXERCISED: OPTIONS advertises `Allow: OPTIONS, POST`, while GET and HEAD return 405 with 0 bytes and no Allow header (evidence/M1-options-matrix.txt:16; M1-anon-probe-matrix.txt:61-62). The POST itself has never been issued (BLOCKED-CRED).

AUTH MODEL: public client — `token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported: ["none"]` is VERIFIED (evidence/M1-openid-configuration.json:17-19), so no Authorization header and no client secret; client_id travels in the form body.

FORM FIELDS — PRIOR-ART: authorization_code grant = grant_type, code, code_verifier, redirect_uri, client_id (cmd/login/main.go:177-183); refresh_token grant = grant_type, refresh_token, client_id with no code_verifier (internal/upstream/client.go:238-245). Prior art also sends `Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, `Accept: application/json` and `anthropic-beta: oauth-2025-04-20` (cmd/login/main.go:191-193; client.go:139, 243). Whether the beta header is REQUIRED is INFERRED and unproven.

RESPONSE SHAPE — PRIOR-ART: JSON with access_token (required by the caller), refresh_token and expires_in (seconds) (cmd/login/main.go:171-175, 208-218; client.go:248-258). The prior art also assumes an OAuth error envelope may arrive with HTTP 200 (client.go:158-169); that is an assumption, not an observation.

parameters.name: anthropic-beta
parameters.description: PRIOR-ART: `oauth-2025-04-20` is sent by the only known working client (cmd/login/main.go:193; internal/upstream/client.go:139, 243). Requiredness is INFERRED, not observed.

requestBody.description: application/x-www-form-urlencoded. Two grants are supported by prior art; field presence differs per grant (see schema description).

grant_type.description: VERIFIED as the supported grant set by discovery metadata (evidence/M1-openid-configuration.json:10-13).

code_verifier.description: authorization_code grant only; the PKCE verifier matching code_challenge. PRIOR-ART (cmd/login/main.go:181).

redirect_uri.description: authorization_code grant only; must equal the value used at /oauth/authorize. PRIOR-ART (cmd/login/main.go:182).

refresh_token.description: refresh_token grant only; no code_verifier is sent on this grant. PRIOR-ART (internal/upstream/client.go:238-242).

200.description: PRIOR-ART / NEVER OBSERVED. Expected token response per the repository's caller. Extra fields may exist; `token_type` and `scope` are not referenced anywhere in the prior art and are therefore unknown.

400.description: PRIOR-ART / INFERRED: OAuth error envelope. `invalid_grant` is named by the login tool's hint text for an expired code (cmd/login/main.go:94). No HTTP error has been observed on this path.

post.summary: Revoke an access or refresh token (RFC 7009)
post.description:
EXISTENCE VERIFIED: OPTIONS advertises `Allow: OPTIONS, POST` (evidence/M1-options-matrix.txt:17) and the endpoint is advertised as `revocation_endpoint` in discovery metadata (evidence/M1-openid-configuration.json:5). GET and HEAD return 405 with 0 bytes and no Allow header (evidence/M1-anon-probe-matrix.txt:63-64).

ALL SEMANTICS ARE INFERRED: no call site exists anywhere in /workspace, so the body is modelled from RFC 7009 §2.1 (form-urlencoded `token` plus optional `token_type_hint`; a `client_id` is plausible but unproven). The response is expected to be 200 with an empty body per RFC 7009 §2.2. No request was made and no response was observed (BLOCKED-CRED).

requestBody.description: application/x-www-form-urlencoded, INFERRED from RFC 7009 §2.1. Not observed.

token.description: The access token or refresh token to revoke.

client_id.description: Plausible but UNPROVEN; no prior-art call site exists.

200.description: INFERRED from RFC 7009 §2.2: empty body on success. NEVER OBSERVED.

get.summary: Static login-complete landing page (the registered redirect_uri)
get.description:
VERIFIED: 200 text/html, 1,769 B, a hand-written static page titled `PhanthyCode 登录完成` with inline CSS and no server-side dynamic data (evidence/M1-anon-probe-matrix.txt:65, 143-152; M1-options-matrix.txt:18).

QUERY HANDLING IS INFERRED: this path is the registered redirect_uri (cmd/login/main.go:148) and the prior art instructs the user to copy the authorization code shown on the page (cmd/login/main.go:69-71), so `code` and `state` are expected to arrive as query parameters and be read client-side. The served HTML is static, so the server does not render them. Whether the page actually displays the code cannot be confirmed without an interactive authorization (BLOCKED-CRED).

IMPORTANT ABSENCES (verified by the complete field list): no `userinfo_endpoint`, no `id_token_signing_alg_values_supported`, no `subject_types_supported`, and no `openid` scope. This is OAuth 2.0 metadata with PKCE under an OIDC file name (docs/01-endpoint-catalog.md:255-257).

VERIFIED: 200 application/json returning exactly one RSA signing key with `kty=RSA`, `e=AQAB`, `use=sig`, `alg=RS256`, `kid=configured-key` (evidence/M1-jwks.json:22, 29-32). Only public key material is present.

INTERPRETATION (INFERRED): the RS256 key suggests the access token may be a signed JWT, but no token was ever observed, so claims, `exp` and signature verification are unverified (BLOCKED-CRED). `kid=configured-key` is a default-style identifier, so key rotation is not demonstrated (docs/01-endpoint-catalog.md:265-279).

post.summary: Anthropic Messages API inference (JSON or SSE stream)
post.description:
EXISTENCE VERIFIED, WIRE CONTRACT PRIOR-ART: OPTIONS advertises `Allow: OPTIONS, POST`; GET and HEAD return 405 with 0 bytes and no Allow header (evidence/M1-options-matrix.txt:23; M1-anon-probe-matrix.txt:70-71). The POST has never been issued on the live target (BLOCKED-CRED).

TWO ALTERNATIVE CREDENTIAL SCHEMES (neither observed live): `x-api-key: <api_key>` is preferred by the prior art when a key exists, otherwise `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` is used (internal/upstream/client.go:344-350; cmd/login/main.go:97-104). Both are modelled as security alternatives. Additional prior-art headers: `x-app: cli`, `User-Agent: phanthycode2api/1.0`, `Accept: application/json, text/event-stream` (client.go:341-343). No `anthropic-version` header is sent anywhere in the repository, so its absence is presumed tolerated (INFERRED).

M6 CORRECTION (VERIFIED-STATIC): the OFFICIAL CLI deletes `x-api-key` and sends `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` only, plus its seven x-phanthy-*/X-Phanthy-* headers, a User-Agent and a fresh x-phanthy-request UUID (evidence/M6-cli-config.txt:145-157). Treat bearerAuth as the primary scheme and apiKeyAuth as an unverified prior-art possibility, never as 'preferred'. Which scheme the target actually accepts on /v1/* remains BLOCKED-CRED.

REQUEST SCHEMA — PRIOR-ART from internal/upstream/payload.go:47-60: model, max_tokens (always serialized; clamped 1..65536 to 8192 by the proxy at payload.go:117-119), messages[], optional system, temperature, top_p, stream, tools, tool_choice, stop_sequences, metadata. The proxy forces `stream: true` (payload.go:109), so a non-streaming JSON response has never been produced by the prior art.

RESPONSE — NEVER OBSERVED. Two media types are modelled: non-streaming `application/json` (loose, inferred from the message_start payload at internal/upstream/sse.go:18-25) and `text/event-stream`. For SSE, the prior art reads only `data:` lines and treats the JSON `type` field as authoritative, ignoring `event:` names; it handles message_start, content_block_start, content_block_delta (text_delta / thinking_delta / input_json_delta), message_delta and message_stop, and has no `error` branch, so a mid-stream error event is silently dropped (internal/upstream/sse.go:188-276; docs/02-usage-semantics.md:165-227). Named examples below are illustrative frame shapes derived from that prior art and its test fixture, not live captures.

ERROR TAXONOMY: 402/429/5xx classification belongs to the proxy, not the target; no 402, 429 or RateLimit-* header has ever been observed (docs/02-usage-semantics.md:283-290). Only 400/401 error envelopes are modelled, and only as documented shape, not as observations on this path.
post.x-evidence-grade: VERIFIED (existence); PRIOR-ART (wire contract); VERIFIED-STATIC (official CLI sends Bearer, not x-api-key); BLOCKED-CRED (live auth scheme + response)

post.description:
UNVERIFIED CONTRACT — DO NOT IMPLEMENT AGAINST THIS OPERATION.

Only existence is established: OPTIONS advertises `Allow: OPTIONS, POST`, while GET and HEAD return 405 with 0 bytes (evidence/M1-options-matrix.txt:26; M1-anon-probe-matrix.txt:74-75). The literal string also appears in the public layout bundle, so a browser client really does call it (evidence/M1-js-static-analysis.txt:60-63). No POST was issued and no response, content type, auth requirement or body has ever been observed.

COMPETING HYPOTHESES (recorded, none asserted):
H1 telemetry/beacon: JSON body, 2xx/204, likely unauthenticated or cookie-auth, empty response.
H2 server-sent event channel: POST-triggered text/event-stream (counter-indication: EventSource is GET-only and GET returns 405 here).
H3 authenticated activity-feed mutation: bearer-auth JSON POST returning a JSON list.
H4 cookie-based action endpoint relying on the anonymous visitor cookies minted by /api/download/client.

Consequently this operation deliberately models NO request body, NO security requirement and NO success schema. The single `default` response is the honest placeholder (docs/01-endpoint-catalog.md:346-367; docs/02-usage-semantics.md:488).

default.description: UNVERIFIED: no POST response has ever been observed. Content type, status code, auth requirement and body are unknown. Do not generate a client from this operation.

get.description:
VERIFIED REDIRECT ONLY: `GET /api/public-assets/` returns 308 with `location: /api/public-assets`, `refresh: 0;url=/api/public-assets`, and an 18-byte body that is literally `/api/public-assets` (evidence/M1-anon-probe-matrix.txt:77, 247-255; M1-options-matrix.txt:28).

The redirect target `/api/public-assets` (no trailing slash) was deliberately NOT followed, so its status, content type, auth requirement and body are unknown (docs/01-endpoint-catalog.md:391-406; acceptance/M1.md:47, 70). This document therefore models the 308 on the slash path and asserts NO 200 body or response schema. The string is called from two public bundles and robots.txt explicitly allows `/api/public-assets/` (evidence/M1-js-static-analysis.txt:59, 62; M1-anon-probe-matrix.txt:383).

308.description: VERIFIED: permanent trailing-slash normalisation. The target is unprobed — no downstream schema is asserted.

text/plain.description: 18-byte body equal to the redirect target. No content-type header was emitted during capture.

get.description:
VERIFIED: 200 text/plain; charset=UTF-8, 527 B, sha256 e9df3e770411dccc14595ac4610fa43e52f6175bedab25f75bd3c464bda64134, `x-nextjs-cache: HIT` (evidence/M1-anon-probe-matrix.txt:80, 369-402).

The body enumerates the site's own private surface as `Disallow` rules (`/api`, `/oauth`, `/v1`, `/admin`, `/account`, `/login`, `/register`, `/payment`, `/app`, `/feedback`, `/docs`, and the password flows) and `Allow`s `/api/public-assets/`. This is a hint, not proof that those paths exist — none was probed except the `/api` and `/v1` prefixes. OPTIONS on this path returns 405 WITH `Allow: GET` / `Allow: HEAD`, unlike the API routes (evidence/M1-options-matrix.txt:31, 370-375).

get.summary: Model catalogue used by the official CLI's model picker
get.description:
EXISTENCE AND METHOD SURFACE VERIFIED-LIVE (M6): OPTIONS returns 204 with `allow: GET, HEAD, OPTIONS`; anonymous GET returns 401 application/json in 79 bytes. This is one of the two routes the official CLI declares as `models` (`https://code.phanthy.com/api/phanthy_code/models`, evidence/M6-cli-config.txt:74-99) and it is the route the CLI calls to populate its model picker.

GUARD: anonymous GET/HEAD return {"error":{"code":"missing_login","message":"Bearer access token is required."}} (79 B, sha256 abeec43bb27c7cbb7c6cd3fa3bbdee2bb9f953de4f6d18d648a416d92116ebe7) with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="phanthy-code", error="invalid_request", error_description="Bearer access token is required."`. The body is byte-identical to the sibling /models/stats path, which indicates one shared guard in front of the /api/phanthy_code/* prefix (evidence/M6-new-endpoint-probes.txt:60-110). There are no access-control-* or ratelimit-* headers and no content-length (chunked).

SUCCESS SCHEMA IS BLOCKED-CRED. Nothing about the 200 body is known: the CLI call was never executed and no token was used, so no field name, shape or example is asserted here. What the public pricing page advertises (13 display aliases with credit multipliers) is PUBLIC-MARKETING metadata and is NOT evidence of this endpoint's wire format (evidence/M6-public-model-catalog.txt:91-105).

CONSEQUENCE: GET /v1/models remains verified absent (HTML 404 shell), but model discovery is not absent from the site — it lives here, behind a bearer guard (docs/01-endpoint-catalog.md §3.16).

SEMANTICS ARE BLOCKED-CRED. "Stats" is INFERRED from the path name and the CLI call site only: a per-model aggregate (usage, quota or pricing metadata) is plausible but unproven. The success body was never observed, so no schema, field or example is asserted. Do not assume it is a rate-limit or quota API.

XPhanthyClient.name: x-phanthy-client
XPhanthyClient.description: VERIFIED-STATIC (official CLI): client discriminator. Lowercase `x-phanthy-` prefix. Optional on the wire; the server's requirement is unverified. Casing must be preserved verbatim (evidence/M6-cli-config.txt:58-73).

XPhanthyClientSource.name: X-Phanthy-Client-Source
XPhanthyClientSource.description: VERIFIED-STATIC: origin marker. The CLI sends `cli` on the message path and `phanthy-codeo` on telemetry. Note the capitalised `X-Phanthy-` prefix used by exactly two of the seven Phanthy headers (evidence/M6-cli-config.txt:58-73).

XPhanthyCliDevice.name: x-phanthy-cli-device
XPhanthyCliDevice.description: VERIFIED-STATIC: base64url(JSON) host fingerprint built by the CLI (hostname, username, platform, arch, OS release, up to 32 IPv4 candidates, interfaces, routes). PRIVACY OBSERVATION, non-exploitative: it is a client-side telemetry design choice, not an access-control mechanism. Never reproduce a real value; the placeholder is <device_fingerprint> (evidence/M6-cli-config.txt:195-201; docs/01-endpoint-catalog.md §5.7).

XPhanthyProduct.name: X-Phanthy-Product
XPhanthyProduct.description: VERIFIED-STATIC: product marker; `phanthy_code` on the two model-discovery calls, `phanthy_codeo` on telemetry (evidence/M6-cli-config.txt:58-73, 172-180). Capitalised `X-Phanthy-` prefix.

XPhanthyProject.name: x-phanthy-project
XPhanthyProject.description: VERIFIED-STATIC: project id of the session, when one is set. Placeholder only (evidence/M6-cli-config.txt:58-73).

XPhanthyRequest.name: x-phanthy-request
XPhanthyRequest.description: VERIFIED-STATIC: per-request correlation UUID, regenerated for every message request. Placeholder only (evidence/M6-cli-config.txt:58-73).

apiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
apiKeyAuth.description: PRIOR-ART alternative for POST /v1/messages: the CLI-facing API key, preferred by the proxy when one exists (internal/upstream/client.go:344-345). M6 CORRECTION: the OFFICIAL CLI explicitly DELETES this header and authenticates with Bearer only (evidence/M6-cli-config.txt:145-157), so this scheme is retained solely as an unverified possibility, not a preference. Whether an API key can still be minted is BLOCKED-CRED: both known create_api_key paths return the HTML 404 shell (evidence/M1-anon-probe-matrix.txt:67-68). Use the placeholder <api_key>.

bearerAuth.description: Authorization: Bearer <access_token>. VERIFIED as the guard on /api/oauth/profile and /api/oauth/claude_cli/roles (evidence/M1-anon-probe-matrix.txt:66, 69, 154-163) and VERIFIED-LIVE as the guard on /api/phanthy_code/models and /api/phanthy_code/models/stats, whose 401 challenge is `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="phanthy-code"` (evidence/M6-new-endpoint-probes.txt:69, 158). VERIFIED-STATIC as the only scheme the official CLI sends on /v1/messages — it deletes x-api-key (evidence/M6-cli-config.txt:145-157). PRIOR-ART as the fallback credential for POST /v1/messages when no API key exists (internal/upstream/client.go:346-350; cmd/login/main.go:97-104). Whether the target accepts Bearer on /v1/* is BLOCKED-CRED. Use the placeholder <access_token>.

ErrorDetail.description: VERIFIED error fields. The same {code,message} pair appears on every observed JSON error.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. Observed values: missing_login, unsupported_response_type, invalid_platform.

ErrorEnvelope.description: VERIFIED target-side error envelope: {"error":{"code","message"}} (evidence/M1-anon-probe-matrix.txt:60, 66, 76). There is no JSON 404 body: unmatched API paths return the Next.js HTML shell (docs/01-endpoint-catalog.md:443-462).

TokenResponse.description: PRIOR-ART / NEVER OBSERVED. Token endpoint response as consumed by the repository: access_token is required by the caller; expires_in drives the client-side expiry; a rotated refresh_token may be returned (cmd/login/main.go:171-175, 208-218; internal/upstream/client.go:248-258). Additional conventional fields such as token_type or scope are unreferenced and therefore unknown.

expires_in.description: Lifetime in seconds (PRIOR-ART). Actual TTL is BLOCKED-CRED.

OpenIDConfiguration.description: VERIFIED field-for-field (evidence/M1-openid-configuration.json:2-26). Note the OIDC absences: no userinfo_endpoint, no id_token signing metadata, no subject_types_supported, no openid scope.

Jwks.description: VERIFIED public key set: exactly one RSA signing key (evidence/M1-jwks.json:22-35).

Jwk.description: VERIFIED RSA public key. `kid=configured-key` is a default-style identifier; rotation is not demonstrated.

n.description: Base64url RSA modulus (public key material only).

AnthropicMessagesRequest.description: PRIOR-ART / BLOCKED-CRED. Modelled from internal/upstream/payload.go:47-60 and the Anthropic Messages API conventions. The proxy always serializes max_tokens and forces stream=true (payload.go:109, 117-119). No live request has been observed.

model.description: Client-facing alias or upstream model ID. Unmapped names pass through unchanged (payload.go:91-97). Two roster layers exist and are NOT joined: a PUBLIC-MARKETING layer of 13 display aliases with credit multipliers (docs/02-usage-semantics.md §6.1, evidence/M6-public-model-catalog.txt) and a PRIOR-ART alias->upstream-ID layer (docs/02-usage-semantics.md §6.2). Neither is a live API catalogue; the alias-to-upstream mapping is unestablished (BLOCKED-CRED).

max_tokens.description: Required in practice: the prior-art struct has no omitempty. The proxy accepts 1..65536 and rewrites anything outside that range to 8192 (payload.go:117-119).

system.description: System prompt. Prior art joins system/developer messages with a blank line (payload.go:141-147, 208-210).

temperature.description: Passed through unmodified by the prior art (payload.go:121-123).

stream.description: Prior art forces this to true (payload.go:109). Whether the target honours stream=false is BLOCKED-CRED.

tools.description: Tool definitions. OpenAI function objects are converted; a missing schema becomes {"type":"object","properties":{}} (payload.go:212-218, 306-335).

content.description: A plain string or an array of content blocks.

ContentBlock.description: Loose content block. The prior art distinguishes text blocks only and flattens image parts to the literal text "[image]" (payload.go:294-298); other block kinds are modelled permissively.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema for the tool input; the prior art defaults a missing schema to an empty object schema.

ToolChoice.description: PRIOR-ART: none / auto / any, or a specific tool (payload.go:337-380).

Usage.description: Token accounting as read from message_start / message_delta (sse.go:18-25, 265-272). PRIOR-ART.

MessageResponse.description: PRIOR-ART / NEVER OBSERVED. Deliberately loose non-streaming message model, inferred from the message_start payload (sse.go:18-25) and the repository's SSE fixture (sse_test.go:11). Do not treat any field as verified.
